summary: Example plan prompt's corpus and tsc spans render empty-but-green when their command fails behind a pipe
acceptance: Rendering examples/prompts/plan.md with no corpus root aborts the render; no shipped example span carries a fallback its pipeline cannot reach
tests: the example plan template's corpus span fails the render when the corpus root is absent
no shipped example prompt span carries a || fallback behind a pipe that swallows its status
notes: Sites: examples/prompts/plan.md:20 (find behind head), :24 (|| true behind tail). Fork the note parked is already ruled — spec/prompt.md *Why: the measured transport facts* rejects per-span tolerance, naming both example chains' spans as digests whose failure means a blind tick. Consumer cost is deliberate: a cascade repo with no corpus now hard-fails tick one instead of planning blind. dash lacks pipefail and the engine spawns sh, so the guard is `test -d`, not a shell option.
